lessons.title: Placement Test Instructions
lessons.content: This is a comprehensive 577-question placement assessment that evaluates your English grammar, vocabulary, and usage skills. Answer all questions to the best of your ability. Your score will determine your placement level.

details.example: This test evaluates your current English proficiency across all grammar topics covered in Units 1-49.
Answer each question by selecting the best option. You can navigate between questions using the question navigator.
Each question is worth 1 point. Your total score determines your placement level.
90-100%: Advanced | 70-89%: Upper Intermediate | 50-69%: Intermediate | 30-49%: Elementary | 0-29%: Beginner
Read each question carefully, eliminate obviously wrong answers, and trust your knowledge. You can change your answers before submitting.
